description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Bangladesh working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when government/public-office schedule only; private-employer, bank, school, industrial-zone, essential-service, regional hill-district, optional-religious and later unlisted ad hoc schedules are not inferred. February 10 is not included because the reported later holiday was industrial-zone specific. Lunar dates may be revised by a later official notice.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Bangladesh authority-scope working days in exact coverage.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Bangladesh working days around Election-period special holiday. | Add or subtract Bangladesh working days around Eid-ul-Adha period.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/bangladesh-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/bangladesh-public-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_bd_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Bangladesh 2026 government public-office holiday schedule plus later election-period national closures

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Bangladesh Working Days
